title: Surface Rust and Python Tests in VSCode Test Editor
description: All semio tests must appear in the VSCode test editor. Go, Playwright, Vitest and F# already show up. Rust (cargo tests in semio/rs/lib.rs) and Python (pytest tests in semio/py/main.py and semio/engine/main.py) are missing. Fix .vscode/settings.json and any configuration so rust-analyzer Test Explorer surfaces the Rust tests and the Python extension discovers the pytest tests.
summary: Wired folder-kit sketchpad filesystem sync end-to-end so desktop folder kits create real directories and move real files/folders when sketchpad issues createFolder, updateFolder, or moveToFolder commands. Extended the folder-backed adapter contract, connected Electron preload/main/renderer IPC for directory creation and entry moves with root-path validation, updated the Node folder adapter used by tests, and added sketchpad coverage asserting folder-store filesystem operations are triggered for folder creation, folder rename, file moves, and folder moves. Verified via successful @semio/desktop integration run and desktop production build; the full @semio/js Vitest suite still has one pre-existing unrelated export-scene-graph failure in the Python-backed report test.
